stem: Meera is helping her mother in the kitchen. She prepares four mixtures. In which mixture are the components spread so evenly that they cannot be seen separately, even with a microscope?

options.text: Salt dissolved completely in a glass of water.
Vegetable pulao with rice, peas and carrot pieces.
Mustard oil poured into a bowl of water.
Sand stirred into a bucket of water.

teacher.key_rationale: Salt fully dissolved in water forms a uniform (homogeneous) mixture; the components are spread evenly and cannot be seen separately. Pulao shows visibly separate components, oil and water form separate layers, and sand settles out of water, so B, C and D are non-uniform mixtures.
